sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，获取nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: It's 6.41 a.m.
sentences.zh: 现在是早上6点41分。

sentences.en: Feeling a little stressed because I'm running late.
sentences.zh: 感觉有点压力，因为我快迟到了。

sentences.en: It's the fourth week of Donald J.
sentences.zh: 这是唐纳德·J·特朗普刑事审判的第四周。

sentences.en: Trump's criminal trial.
sentences.zh: 这是白领犯罪审判。

sentences.en: It's a white collar trial.
sentences.zh: 这是白领犯罪审判。

sentences.en: Most of the witnesses we've heard from have been, I think, typical.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们听取的大多数证人都很典型。

sentences.en: White collar witnesses in terms of their professions.
sentences.zh: 就职业而言，他们是白领证人。

sentences.en: Got a former publisher.
sentences.zh: 有前出版商。

sentences.en: A lawyer.
sentences.zh: 律师。

sentences.en: Accountants.
sentences.zh: 会计师。

sentences.en: The witness today, a little less typical.
sentences.zh: 今天的证人，没那么典型。

sentences.en: Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 斯托米·丹尼尔斯。

sentences.en: Porn star in a New York criminal courtroom.
sentences.zh: 出现在纽约刑事法庭上的色情明星。

sentences.en: In front of a jury, more accustomed to the types of witnesses they've already seen.
sentences.zh: 在陪审团面前，他们更习惯于已经见过的那些证人类型。

sentences.en: There's a lot that could go wrong.
sentences.zh: 有很多事情可能会出错。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: What happened when Stormy Daniels took the stand for eight hours in the first criminal trial of Donald J.
sentences.zh: 当斯托米·丹尼尔斯在唐纳德·J·特朗普的首场刑事审判中出庭作证八小时时，发生了什么？

sentences.en: Trump?
sentences.zh: 特朗普？

sentences.en: As before, my colleague, Jonah Bromwich, was inside the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，我的同事乔纳·布罗姆维奇当时就在法庭内。

sentences.en: It's Friday, May 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月10日，星期五。

sentences.en: So, it's now day 14 of this trial.
sentences.zh: 现在是这次审判的第14天。

sentences.en: And I think it's worth having you briefly and in broad strokes catch listeners up on the biggest developments that have occurred since you were last on,
sentences.zh: 我想有必要让你简要地、概括性地向听众介绍一下你上次来之后发生的最大进展，

sentences.en: which was the day that opening arguments were made by both the defense and the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 也就是辩方和控方进行开庭陈述的那一天。

sentences.en: So, just give us that brief recap.
sentences.zh: 所以，请给我们做一个简短的回顾。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: It's all been the prosecution's case so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，一切都是控方的举证。

sentences.en: And prosecutors have a saying, which is that the evidence is coming in great.
sentences.zh: 检察官有句名言，就是证据非常充分。

sentences.en: And I think for this prosecution, which is trying to show that Trump falsified business records to cover up a sex scandal,
sentences.zh: 我认为对于这次控方来说，他们试图证明特朗普伪造商业记录以掩盖性丑闻，

sentences.en: to ease his way into the White House in 2016, the evidence has been coming in pretty well.
sentences.zh: 从而为他在2016年入主白宫铺平道路，证据确实非常充分。

sentences.en: It's come in well through David Pecker, former publisher of the National Enquirer,
sentences.zh: 通过《国家询问报》前出版商大卫·佩克，证据呈现得很好，

sentences.en: who testified that he entered into a secret plot with Trump and Michael Cohen, his fixer at the time, to suppress negative stories about Trump, the candidate.
sentences.zh: 他作证说他与特朗普以及当时他的“清道夫”迈克尔·科恩达成了一项秘密阴谋，以压制关于候选人特朗普的负面报道。

sentences.en: It came in pretty well through Keith Davidson, who was a lawyer to Stormy Daniels in 2016 and negotiated the hush money payment.
sentences.zh: 通过2016年担任斯托米·丹尼尔斯律师并协商封口费支付事宜的基思·戴维森，证据也呈现得相当好。

sentences.en: And we've seen all these little bits and pieces of evidence that tell the story that prosecutors want to tell.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到了所有这些零碎的证据，它们讲述了检察官想要讲述的故事。

sentences.en: And the case makes sense so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，这个案子逻辑通顺。

sentences.en: We can't tell what the jury's thinking, as we always say.
sentences.zh: 正如我们常说的，我们无法得知陪审团在想什么。

sentences.en: But we can tell that there's a narrative that's coherent and that matches up with the prosecution's opening statement.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以看出，叙事是连贯的，并且与控方的开庭陈述相吻合。

sentences.en: Then we come to Tuesday, and that day really marks the first time that the prosecution's strategy seems a little bit risky,
sentences.zh: 然后到了周二，那一天确实标志着控方的策略似乎第一次显得有点冒险，

sentences.en: because that's the day that Stormy Daniels gets called to the witness stand.
sentences.zh: 因为那天斯托米·丹尼尔斯被传唤到证人席。

sentences.en: Okay, well, just explain why the prosecution putting Stormy Daniels on the stand would be so risky.
sentences.zh: 好的，请解释一下为什么控方让斯托米·丹尼尔斯出庭会如此冒险。

sentences.en: And I guess it makes sense to answer that in the context of why the prosecution is calling her as a witness at all.
sentences.zh: 我想在控方为何传唤她作为证人的背景下回答这个问题是有意义的。

sentences.en: Well, you can see why it makes sense to have her.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你可以看出为什么传唤她是有道理的。

sentences.en: The hush money payment was to her.
sentences.zh: 封口费是付给她的。

sentences.en: The cover-up of the hush money payment in some ways concerns her.
sentences.zh: 封口费的掩盖在某种程度上与她有关。

sentences.en: And so she's this character who's very much at the center of the story.
sentences.zh: 所以她是这个故事核心的关键人物。

sentences.en: But according to prosecutors, she's not at the center of the crime.
sentences.zh: 但据检察官称，她并不是犯罪的核心。

sentences.en: The prosecution is telling a story, and they hope a compelling one.
sentences.zh: 控方正在讲述一个故事，他们希望这是一个引人入胜的故事。

sentences.en: And arguably that story starts with Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 可以说，这个故事始于斯托米·丹尼尔斯。

sentences.en: It starts in 2006 when Stormy Daniels says that she and Trump had sex, which is something that Trump has always denied.
sentences.zh: 它始于2006年，当时斯托米·丹尼尔斯说她和特朗普发生了性关系，这是特朗普一直否认的。

sentences.en: So if prosecutors were to not call Stormy Daniels to the stand, you would have this big hole in the case.
sentences.zh: 所以如果检察官不传唤斯托米·丹尼尔斯出庭，你的案子就会有一个巨大的漏洞。

sentences.en: It would be like effect, effect, effect.
sentences.zh: 那就像是结果、结果、结果。

sentences.en: But where is the cause?
sentences.zh: 但原因在哪里？

sentences.en: Where is the person who set off this chain reaction?
sentences.zh: 那个引发这一连锁反应的人在哪里？

sentences.en: But Stormy Daniels is a porn star.
sentences.zh: 但斯托米·丹尼尔斯是一位色情明星。

sentences.en: She's there to testify about sex.
sentences.zh: 她在那儿是为了作证关于性行为的事。

sentences.en: Sex and pornography are things that the jurors were not asked about during jury selection.
sentences.zh: 性和色情是陪审员在陪审团遴选过程中没有被问及的事情。

sentences.en: And those are subjects that bring up all kinds of different complex reactions in people.
sentences.zh: 而这些话题在人们心中会引发各种各样复杂的反应。

sentences.en: And so when the prosecutors bring Stormy Daniels to the courtroom, it's very difficult to know how the jurors will take it.
sentences.zh: 所以当检察官把斯托米·丹尼尔斯带到法庭时，很难知道陪审员会作何感想。

sentences.en: Particularly given that she's about to describe a sexual episode that she says she had with the former president.
sentences.zh: 特别是考虑到她即将描述她声称与前总统发生的一次性行为。

sentences.en: Will the jurors think that makes sense as they sit here and try to decide a falsifying business records case?
sentences.zh: 当陪审员坐在这里试图决定一起伪造商业记录的案件时，他们会认为这有意义吗？

sentences.en: Or will they ask themselves, why are we hearing this?
sentences.zh: 还是他们会问自己，我们为什么要听这些？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So the reason why this is the first time that the prosecution's strategy is, for journalists like you, a little bit confusing,
sentences.zh: 所以，对于像你这样的记者来说，这是控方策略第一次让人感到困惑的原因，

sentences.en: is because it's the first time that the prosecution seems to be taking a genuine risk in what they're putting before these jurors.
sentences.zh: 是因为这是控方似乎第一次在他们呈交给陪审员的内容上冒真正的风险。

sentences.en: Everything else has been kind of cut and dry and a little bit more mechanical.
sentences.zh: 其他一切都相当简单明了，也更机械化一些。

sentences.en: This is just a wild card.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个变数。

sentences.en: This is like live ammunition to some extent.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上就像是实弹。

sentences.en: Everything else is settled and controlled and they know what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 其他一切都是既定的、可控的，他们知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: With Stormy Daniels, that's not the case.
sentences.zh: 但对于斯托米·丹尼尔斯，情况并非如此。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So walk us through the testimony.
sentences.zh: 那么请带我们了解一下证词内容。

sentences.en: When the prosecution brings her to the stand, what actually happens?
sentences.zh: 当控方带她上证人席时，实际上发生了什么？

sentences.en: It starts, as every witness does, with what's called direct examination, which is a fancy word for saying prosecutors question Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 它始于所谓的直接询问，就像每位证人一样，这是检察官质询斯托米·丹尼尔斯的专业说法。

sentences.en: And they have her tell her story.
sentences.zh: 他们让她讲述她的故事。

sentences.en: First, they have her tell the jury about her education and where she grew up and her professional experience.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们让她向陪审团讲述她的教育背景、成长经历以及职业经验。

sentences.en: And because of Stormy Daniels' biography, that quickly goes into stripping and then goes into making adult filMs.
sentences.zh: 由于斯托米·丹尼尔斯的履历，这很快就转到了脱衣舞，然后转到了拍摄成人电影。

sentences.en: And I thought the prosecutor who questioned her, Susan Hoffinger, had this nice touch in talking about that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得质询她的检察官苏珊·霍芬格在谈论这一点时处理得很好。

sentences.en: Because not only did she ask Daniels about acting in adult films, but she asked her about writing and directing them too.
sentences.zh: 因为她不仅问了丹尼尔斯关于出演成人电影的事，还问了她关于编剧和导演的事。

sentences.en: Emphasizing the more professional aspects of that work and giving a little more credit to the witness.
sentences.zh: 强调了这项工作中更专业的一面，并给予了证人更多的尊重。

sentences.en: As if to say, well, you may think this or you may think that, but this is a person with dignity who took what she did seriously.
sentences.zh: 仿佛在说，好吧，你可能这么想或那么想，但这是一个有尊严的人，她认真对待自己的工作。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: What's your first impression of Daniels as a witness?
sentences.zh: 你对丹尼尔斯作为证人的第一印象是什么？

sentences.en: Yes, it's very clear that she's nervous.
sentences.zh: 是的，很明显她很紧张。

sentences.en: She's speaking faSt.
sentences.zh: 她说话很快。

sentences.en: She's laughing to herself and making small jokes.
sentences.zh: 她自顾自地笑，还开些小玩笑。

sentences.en: But the tension in the room is so serious from the beginning, from the moment she enters, that those jokes aren't landing.
sentences.zh: 但从一开始，从她进入房间的那一刻起，房间里的气氛就非常严肃，那些玩笑根本没起到作用。

sentences.en: So it just feels like really heavy and still and almost oppressive in there.
sentences.zh: 所以那里感觉非常沉重、静止，甚至令人压抑。

sentences.en: So Daniel's talking quickly, seeming nervous, giving more answers than are being asked of her by the prosecution,
sentences.zh: 所以丹尼尔斯说话很快，看起来很紧张，给出的回答比控方要求的要多，

sentences.en: even before we get to the sexual encounter that she's about to describe.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我们谈到她即将描述的性接触之前就是这样。

sentences.en: All of that presents a really discomforting impression, I would say.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都呈现出一种非常令人不安的印象，我想说。

sentences.en: And how does this move towards the encounter that Daniels ultimately has?
sentences.zh: 那么，这如何引向丹尼尔斯最终经历的那次接触？

sentences.en: It starts at a golf tournament in 2006 in Lake Tahoe, Nevada.
sentences.zh: 它始于2006年内华达州太浩湖的一场高尔夫球锦标赛。

sentences.en: Daniels meets Trump there.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔斯在那里遇到了特朗普。

sentences.en: There are other celebrities there too.
sentences.zh: 那里还有其他名人。

sentences.en: They chatted very briefly.
sentences.zh: 他们聊得很短。

sentences.en: And then she received a dinner invitation from him.
sentences.zh: 然后她收到了他的晚餐邀请。

sentences.en: She thought it over, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说她考虑了一下。

sentences.en: And she goes to have dinner with Trump.
sentences.zh: 然后她去和特朗普共进晚餐。

sentences.en: Not at a restaurant, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，不是在餐厅。

sentences.en: But she's invited to join him in the hotel suite.
sentences.zh: 而是她被邀请到酒店套房和他会合。

sentences.en: So she gets to the hotel suite.
sentences.zh: 所以她到了酒店套房。

sentences.en: And his bodyguard is there.
sentences.zh: 他的保镖在那里。

sentences.en: And the hotel door is cracked open.
sentences.zh: 酒店门虚掩着。

sentences.en: And the bodyguard greets her and says she looks nice, this and that.
sentences.zh: 保镖迎接她，说她看起来很漂亮，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And she goes in.
sentences.zh: 然后她进去了。

sentences.en: And there's Donald Trump, just as expected.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普就在那里，正如预期的那样。

sentences.en: But what's not expected, she says, is that he's not wearing what you would wear to a dinner with a stranger.
sentences.zh: 但她说，意想不到的是，他穿的不是你会穿去和陌生人共进晚餐的衣服。

sentences.en: But instead, she says, silk or satin pajamas.
sentences.zh: 相反，她说，是丝绸或缎子的睡衣。

sentences.en: She asked him to change, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说她让他换掉。

sentences.en: And he obliges.
sentences.zh: 他照做了。

sentences.en: He goes and he puts on a dress shirt and dress pants.
sentences.zh: 他去换上了一件正装衬衫和西裤。

sentences.en: And they sit down at the hotel suite's dining room table.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在酒店套房的餐桌旁。

sentences.en: And they have a kind of bizarre dinner.
sentences.zh: 他们吃了一顿有点离奇的晚餐。

sentences.en: Trump is asking her very personal questions about pornography and safe sex.
sentences.zh: 特朗普问她关于色情和安全性行为的非常私人的问题。

sentences.en: And she testifies that she teased him about how kind of vain and pompous he is.
sentences.zh: 她作证说她取笑他有多么虚荣和自负。

sentences.en: And then at some point, she goes to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 然后在某个时候，她去了洗手间。

sentences.en: And she sees that he has got his toiletries in there, his Old Spice, his gold tweezers.
sentences.zh: 她看到他在里面放了洗漱用品，他的Old Spice古龙水，他的金镊子。

sentences.en: Very specific details.
sentences.zh: 非常具体的细节。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're getting a ton of detail in this scene.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们在这一幕中得到了大量的细节。

sentences.en: And the reason we're getting those is because prosecutors are trying to elicit those details to establish that this is a credible person.
sentences.zh: 我们得到这些细节的原因是检察官试图引出这些细节，以证明这是一个可信的人。

sentences.en: That this thing did happen, despite what Donald Trump and his lawyers say.
sentences.zh: 尽管唐纳德·特朗普和他的律师怎么说，这件事确实发生了。

sentences.en: And the reason you can know it happened, prosecutors seem to be saying, is because look at all these details.
sentences.zh: 检察官似乎在说，你可以知道它发生了，因为看看所有这些细节。

sentences.en: She can still summon up.
sentences.zh: 她仍然能回忆起来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: She comes out of the bathroom and she says that Donald Trump is on the hotel bed.
sentences.zh: 她从洗手间出来，说唐纳德·特朗普在酒店床上。

sentences.en: And what stands out to me there is what she describes as a very intense physical reaction.
sentences.zh: 那里让我印象深刻的是她所描述的一种非常强烈的身体反应。

sentences.en: She says that she blacked out.
sentences.zh: 她说她断片了。

sentences.en: And she quickly clarifies she doesn't mean from drugs or alcohol.
sentences.zh: 她很快澄清说她不是指药物或酒精。

sentences.en: She means that, she says, that the intensity of this experience was such that suddenly she can't remember every detail.
sentences.zh: 她是说，她说，这种经历的强度以至于她突然无法记住每一个细节。

sentences.en: The prosecution asks a question that cuts directly to the sex.
sentences.zh: 控方问了一个直击性行为的问题。

sentences.en: Essentially, did you start having sex with him?
sentences.zh: 本质上是，你开始和他发生性关系了吗？

sentences.en: And Daniel says that she did.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔斯说她确实发生了。

sentences.en: And she continues to provide more details than even, I think, the prosecution wanted.
sentences.zh: 而且她继续提供了比我认为控方想要的还要多的细节。

sentences.en: And I think we don't want to go chapter and verse through this claimed sexual encounter.
sentences.zh: 我想我们不想逐字逐句地复述这次所谓的性接触。

sentences.en: But I wonder what details stand out and which details feel important, given the prosecution's strategy here.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，考虑到控方在这里的策略，哪些细节脱颖而出，哪些细节感觉很重要。

sentences.en: All the details stand out because it's a story about having had sex with the former president.
sentences.zh: 所有的细节都显得格外突出，因为这是一个关于曾与前总统发生性关系的故事。

sentences.en: And the more salacious and more private the details feel, the more you're going to remember them.
sentences.zh: 细节越是显得淫秽、越是私密，你就越会记住它们。

sentences.en: So we'll remember that Stormy Daniels said what position they had sex in.
sentences.zh: 所以我们会记住斯托米·丹尼尔斯所说的他们发生性关系的姿势。

sentences.en: We'll remember that she said he didn't use a condom.
sentences.zh: 我们会记住她说他没用避孕套。

sentences.en: And whether that's important to the prosecution's case, now that's a much harder question to answer, as we've been saying.
sentences.zh: 正如我们一直所说的，这对于检方的案子是否重要，是一个更难回答的问题。

sentences.en: But what I can tell you is as she's describing having had sex with Donald Trump, and Donald Trump is sitting right there.
sentences.zh: 但我能告诉你的是，当她描述与唐纳德·特朗普发生性关系时，唐纳德·特朗普就坐在那里。

sentences.en: And Eric Trump, his son, is sitting behind him,
sentences.zh: 而他的儿子埃里克·特朗普就坐在他身后，

sentences.en: seeming to turn like a different color as he hears this embarrassment of his father being described to a courtroom full of reporters at this trial.
sentences.zh: 当他听到父亲这些令人尴尬的事在审判现场被描述给满屋子的记者听时，他似乎脸色都变了。

sentences.en: It's hard to even describe the energy in that room.
sentences.zh: 很难形容当时房间里的气氛。

sentences.en: It was like nothing I had ever experienced.
sentences.zh: 那是我从未经历过的。

sentences.en: And it was just Daniels' testimony and seemingly the former president's emotions.
sentences.zh: 当时只有丹尼尔斯的证词，以及前总统似乎流露出的情绪。

sentences.en: And you almost felt like you were trapped in there with both of them as this description was happening.
sentences.zh: 当这些描述发生时，你几乎感觉自己和他们两人一起被困在那里。

sentences.en: Well, I think it's important to try to understand why the prosecution is getting these details, these salacious, carnal, pick your word,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为重要的是要理解为什么检方要获取这些细节，这些淫秽的、肉欲的——随你怎么称呼——

sentences.en: graphic details about sex with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 关于与唐纳德·特朗普发生性关系的露骨细节。

sentences.en: What is the value?
sentences.zh: 价值何在？

sentences.en: If other details are clearly making the point that she's recollecting something?
sentences.zh: 如果其他细节已经清楚地表明她在回忆某件事？

sentences.en: Well, I think at this point we can only speculate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想目前我们只能猜测。

sentences.en: But one thing we can say is this was uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 但有一点我们可以说，那就是这让人很不舒服。

sentences.en: This felt bad.
sentences.zh: 这感觉很糟糕。

sentences.en: And remember, prosecutor's story is not about the sex.
sentences.zh: 记住，检察官的故事不是关于性本身。

sentences.en: It's about trying to hide this sex.
sentences.zh: 而是关于试图掩盖这段性关系。

sentences.en: So if you're trying to show a jury why it might be worthwhile to hide a story, it might be worth providing lots of salacious details that a person would want to hide.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你想向陪审团展示为什么掩盖一个故事是值得的，那么提供大量当事人想要掩盖的淫秽细节或许是有意义的。

sentences.en: Exposing them to how bad that story feels and reminding them that if they had been voters and they had heard that story, and in fact, they asked Daniels this very question.
sentences.zh: 让他们感受到那个故事有多糟糕，并提醒他们，如果他们是选民，如果他们听到了那个故事——事实上，他们确实问了丹尼尔斯这个问题。

sentences.en: If you hadn't accepted hush money, if you hadn't signed that NDA, is this the story you would have told?
sentences.zh: 如果你没有接受封口费，如果你没有签署那份保密协议，这会是你本来会讲的故事吗？

sentences.en: And she said, yes.
sentences.zh: 她说，是的。

sentences.en: And so where I think they're going with this, but we can't really be sure yet, is that they're going to tell the jurors, hey, that story,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们想表达的是——尽管我们还不能完全确定——他们会告诉陪审员，嘿，那个故事，

sentences.en: you can see why he wanted to cover that up, can't you?
sentences.zh: 你能明白他为什么要掩盖它，对吧？

sentences.en: You mentioned the hush money payments.
sentences.zh: 你提到了封口费支付。

sentences.en: What testimony does Daniels offer about that?
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔斯对此提供了什么证词？

sentences.en: And how does it advance the prosecution's case of business fraud related to the hush money payments?
sentences.zh: 它又是如何推进检方关于与封口费相关的商业欺诈案的？

sentences.en: So little evidence that it's almost laughable.
sentences.zh: 证据少到几乎可笑。

sentences.en: She says that she received the hush money, but we actually already heard another witness, her lawyer at the time, Keith Davidson,
sentences.zh: 她说她收到了封口费，但我们实际上已经听取了另一位证人，她当时的律师基思·戴维森的证词，

sentences.en: testified that he had received the hush money payment on her behalf.
sentences.zh: 他作证说他代表她收到了封口费。

sentences.en: And she testified about feeling as if she had to sell this story because the election was fast approaching,
sentences.zh: 她作证说，因为选举临近，她觉得必须卖掉这个故事，

sentences.en: almost as if her leverage was slipping away because she knew this would be bad for Trump.
sentences.zh: 就好像她的筹码正在流失，因为她知道这对特朗普不利。

sentences.en: That feels important, but just tell me why it's important.
sentences.zh: 这感觉很重要，但请告诉我为什么它很重要。

sentences.en: Well, what the prosecution has been arguing is that Trump covered up this hush money payment in order to conceal a different crime.
sentences.zh: 嗯，检方一直主张的是，特朗普掩盖这笔封口费是为了隐瞒另一项罪行。

sentences.en: And that crime, they say, was to promote his election to the presidency by illegal means.
sentences.zh: 他们说，那项罪行就是通过非法手段促进他当选总统。

sentences.en: Right, we've talked about this in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 没错，我们过去讨论过这个问题。

sentences.en: So when Daniels ties her side of the payment into the election, it just reminds the jurors maybe, oh, right, this is what they're arguing.
sentences.zh: 所以当丹尼尔斯将她那部分的付款与选举联系起来时，这只是提醒陪审员，哦，对了，这就是他们所主张的。

sentences.en: So how does the prosecution end this very dramatic and, from everything you're saying, very tense questioning of Stormy Daniels about this encounter?
sentences.zh: 那么，检方是如何结束这次非常戏剧化，而且据你所说，对斯托米·丹尼尔斯关于这次遭遇的质询非常紧张的环节的呢？

sentences.en: Well, before they can even end, the defense lawyers go and they consult among themselves.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在他们结束之前，辩护律师们就聚在一起商量。

sentences.en: And then with the jury out of the room, one of them stands up and he says that the defense is moving for a mistrial.
sentences.zh: 然后在陪审团离开房间后，其中一人站起来说，辩方要求宣布审判无效。

sentences.en: On what terms?
sentences.zh: 基于什么理由？

sentences.en: He says that the testimony offered by Daniels that morning is so prejudicial, so damning to Trump in the eyes of the jury, that the trial can no longer be fair.
sentences.zh: 他说丹尼尔斯那天早上提供的证词太具偏见，在陪审团眼中对特朗普太具毁灭性，以至于审判已无法保持公正。

sentences.en: Like, how could these jurors have heard these details and still be fair when they render their verdict?
sentences.zh: 比如，这些陪审员怎么可能在听了这些细节后，在做出裁决时还能保持公正？

sentences.en: And he says a memorable expression.
sentences.zh: 他用了一个令人难忘的表达。

sentences.en: He says you can't unring that bell, meaning they heard it.
sentences.zh: 他说你无法让钟声倒转，意思是他们已经听到了。

sentences.en: They can't unhear it.
sentences.zh: 他们无法假装没听过。

sentences.en: It's over.
sentences.zh: 结束了。

sentences.en: Throw out this trial.
sentences.zh: 废除这次审判吧。

sentences.en: It should be done.
sentences.zh: 应该到此为止。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And what is the response from the judge?
sentences.zh: 法官的回应是什么？

sentences.en: So the judge, Juan Mershon, he hears them out.
sentences.zh: 法官胡安·默尚听取了他们的意见。

sentences.en: I mean, he really hears them out.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他真的听取了他们的意见。

sentences.en: But at the end of their arguments, he says, I do think she went a little too far.
sentences.zh: 但在他们辩论结束时，他说，我确实认为她有点过火了。

sentences.en: He says that.
sentences.zh: 他说了那句话。

sentences.en: He said there were things that were better left unsaid.
sentences.zh: 他说有些话最好还是别说。

sentences.en: By Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 由斯托米·丹尼尔斯说出来。

sentences.en: By Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 由斯托米·丹尼尔斯说出来。

sentences.en: And he acknowledges that she's a difficult witness.
sentences.zh: 他也承认她是一个难对付的证人。

sentences.en: But he says the remedy for that is not a mistrial, is not stopping the whole thing right now.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，补救措施不是宣布审判无效，也不是现在就停止整个审判。

sentences.en: The remedy for that is cross-examination.
sentences.zh: 补救措施是交叉质询。

sentences.en: If the defense feels that there are issues with her story, issues with her credibility, they can ask her whatever they want.
sentences.zh: 如果辩方觉得她的故事有问题，她的可信度有问题，他们可以问她任何想问的问题。

sentences.en: They can try to win the jury back over her.
sentences.zh: 他们可以尝试在陪审团面前赢回局面。

sentences.en: If they think this jury has been poisoned by this witness, well, this is their time to provide the antidote.
sentences.zh: 如果他们认为这个陪审团已经被这个证人毒害了，那么，现在就是他们提供解药的时候了。

sentences.en: The antidote is cross-examination.
sentences.zh: 解药就是交叉质询。

sentences.en: And soon enough, cross-examination starts.
sentences.zh: 很快，交叉质询就开始了。

sentences.en: And it is exactly as intense and combative as we expected.
sentences.zh: 而且正如我们预料的那样，它非常激烈且具有对抗性。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的。

sentences.en: Like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So, Jonah, how would you characterize the defense's overall strategy in this intense cross-examination of Stormy Daniels?
sentences.zh: 那么，乔纳，你如何评价辩方在这次对斯托米·丹尼尔斯的激烈交叉质询中的整体策略？

sentences.en: People know the word impeach from presidential impeachments, but it has a meaning in law, too.
sentences.zh: 人们从总统弹劾案中知道“弹劾”（impeach）这个词，但在法律中它也有含义。

sentences.en: You impeach a witness and specifically their credibility.
sentences.zh: 你要弹劾一名证人，具体来说是弹劾他们的可信度。

sentences.en: And that's what the defense is going for here.
sentences.zh: 这就是辩方在这里的目标。

sentences.en: They are going to try to make Stormy Daniels look like a liar, a fraud, an extortionist, a money-grubbing opportunist
sentences.zh: 他们试图让斯托米·丹尼尔斯看起来像个骗子、欺诈者、勒索者、贪财的机会主义者，

sentences.en: who wanted to take advantage of Trump and sought to do so by any means necessary.
sentences.zh: 一个想利用特朗普，并试图不择手段达到目的的人。

sentences.en: And what did that impeachment strategy look like in the courtroom?
sentences.zh: 这种弹劾策略在法庭上是什么样的？

sentences.en: The defense lawyer who questions Stormy Daniels is a woman named Susan Necklace.
sentences.zh: 质询斯托米·丹尼尔斯的辩护律师是一位名叫苏珊·内克莱斯的女性。

sentences.en: She's defended Trump before, and she's a bit of a cross-examination specialiSt.
sentences.zh: 她以前为特朗普辩护过，而且是一位交叉质询专家。

sentences.en: We even saw her during jury selection bring up these past details to kind of confront jurors who had said nasty things about Trump on social media with.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至在陪审团遴选期间看到她提出这些过去的细节，去对抗那些在社交媒体上对特朗普发表过恶毒言论的陪审员。

sentences.en: And she wants to do the same thing with Daniels.
sentences.zh: 她想对丹尼尔斯做同样的事情。

sentences.en: She wants to bring up old interviews and old tweets and things that Daniels has said in the past that don't match what Daniels is saying from the stance.
sentences.zh: 她想翻出旧的采访、旧的推文以及丹尼尔斯过去说过的话，这些话与丹尼尔斯在证人席上所说的不符。

sentences.en: What's a specific example, and do they land?
sentences.zh: 有什么具体的例子吗？它们奏效了吗？

sentences.en: Some of them land, and some of them don't.
sentences.zh: 有些奏效了，有些没有。

sentences.en: One specific example is that Necklace confronts Daniels with this old tweet where Daniels says that she's going to dance down the street if Trump goes to jail.
sentences.zh: 一个具体的例子是，内克莱斯用一条旧推文质问丹尼尔斯，丹尼尔斯在推文中说如果特朗普入狱，她要在街上跳舞。

sentences.en: And what she's trying to show there is that Daniels is out for revenge, that she hates Trump, and that she wants to see him go to jail.
sentences.zh: 她试图证明的是，丹尼尔斯是为了报复，她恨特朗普，她想看到他入狱。

sentences.en: And that's why she's testifying against him.
sentences.zh: 这就是她出庭作证反对他的原因。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And Daniels is very interesting during the cross-examination.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔斯在交叉质询期间的表现非常有趣。

sentences.en: It's almost as if she's a different person.
sentences.zh: 她简直像变了个人似的。

sentences.en: She kind of squares her shoulders, and she sits up a little straighter, and she leans forward.
sentences.zh: 她挺起肩膀，坐得更直了一些，身体前倾。

sentences.en: Daniels is ready to fight, but it doesn't quite land.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔斯准备好反击了，但这并没有完全奏效。

sentences.en: The tweet actually says,
sentences.zh: 那条推文实际上写着，

sentences.en: I'll dance down the street when he's selected to go to jail.
sentences.zh: 当他被选入监狱时，我要在街上跳舞。

sentences.en: And Daniels goes off on this digression about how she knows that people don't get selected to go to jail.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔斯开始跑题，说她知道人们不会被“选入”监狱。

sentences.en: That's not how it works.
sentences.zh: 事情不是那样运作的。

sentences.en: But she can't really unseat this argument that she's a political enemy of Donald Trump's.
sentences.zh: 但她无法真正消除她是唐纳德·特朗普政治敌人的这一论点。

sentences.en: So that one kind of sticks, I would say.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得那一点有点站得住脚。

sentences.en: But there are other moves that Necklace tries to pull that don't stick.
sentences.zh: 但内克莱斯试图采取的其他行动并没有奏效。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: So unlike the prosecution, which typically used words like adult, adult film,
sentences.zh: 与检方不同，检方通常使用“成人”、“成人电影”等词汇，

sentences.en: Necklace seems to be taking every chance she can get to say porn or pornography or porn star to make it sound bass or dirty.
sentences.zh: 内克莱斯似乎抓住一切机会说“色情”、“色情片”或“色情明星”，让它听起来很低俗或肮脏。

sentences.en: And so when she starts to ask Daniels about actually being in pornography, writing, acting, and directing sex films, she tries to land a punchline, Necklace does.
sentences.zh: 所以当她开始问丹尼尔斯关于实际从事色情行业、写作、表演和导演性爱电影的事情时，内克莱斯试图抛出一个笑点。

sentences.en: She says, So you have a lot of experience making phony stories about sex appear to be real, right?
sentences.zh: 她说，所以你有很多让虚假的性故事看起来像真的一样的经验，对吧？

sentences.en: As if to say, perhaps this story you have told about entering Trump's suite in Lake Tahoe and having sex with him was made up.
sentences.zh: 仿佛在说，也许你讲述的关于进入特朗普在太浩湖的套房并与他发生性关系的故事是编造的。

sentences.en: Just another one of your fictional stories about sex.
sentences.zh: 只是你又一个关于性的虚构故事而已。

sentences.en: But Daniels comes back and says,
sentences.zh: 但丹尼尔斯回击说，

sentences.en: The sex in the films, it's very much real, just like what happened to me in that room.
sentences.zh: 电影里的性爱是非常真实的，就像我在那个房间里经历的一样。

sentences.en: And so when you have this kind of combat of lawyer cross-examining very aggressively and the witness fighting back,
sentences.zh: 所以，当你有这种律师非常激进地交叉质询，而证人进行反击的对抗时，

sentences.en: you can feel the energy in the room shift as one lands a blow or the other does.
sentences.zh: 当一方或另一方得分时，你能感觉到房间里的气氛在变化。

sentences.en: But here, Daniels lands one back.
sentences.zh: 但在这里，丹尼尔斯回击了一次。

sentences.en: And the other issue that I think Susan Necklace runs into is she tries to draw out disparities from interviews that Daniels gave,
sentences.zh: 我认为苏珊·内克莱斯遇到的另一个问题是，她试图从丹尼尔斯接受的采访中找出差异，

sentences.en: particularly to InTouch very early on once the story was out.
sentences.zh: 特别是在故事传出后，丹尼尔斯很早接受《InTouch》杂志的采访。

sentences.en: It's kind of like a tabloid magazine.
sentences.zh: 那就像是一本小报杂志。

sentences.en: But some of the disparities don't seem to be landing quite like Necklace would want.
sentences.zh: 但有些差异似乎并没有像内克莱斯想要的那样奏效。

sentences.en: So she tries to do this complicated thing about where the bodyguard was in the room when Daniels walked into the room as described in an interview in a magazine.
sentences.zh: 所以她试图做一件复杂的事情，关于丹尼尔斯走进房间时保镖在哪里，正如杂志采访中所描述的那样。

sentences.en: But in that magazine interview, as it turns out,
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，在那次杂志采访中，

sentences.en: Daniels mentioned that Trump was wearing pajamas.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔斯提到特朗普穿着睡衣。

sentences.en: And so if I'm a juror, I don't care where the bodyguard is.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我是陪审员，我不在乎保镖在哪里。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about, oh, yeah, I remember that Stormy Daniels said now in 2024 that Trump was wearing pajamas.
sentences.zh: 我在想，哦，对了，我记得斯托米·丹尼尔斯现在在2024年说特朗普当时穿着睡衣。

sentences.en: I'm curious if, as somebody in the room, you felt that the defense was effective in undermining Stormy Daniels' credibility.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，作为在场的人，你是否觉得辩方在削弱斯托米·丹尼尔斯的可信度方面是有效的？

sentences.en: Because what I took from the earlier part of our conversation was that Stormy Daniels is in this courtroom on behalf of the prosecution to tell a story that's uncomfortable
sentences.zh: 因为我从我们谈话的前半部分理解到，斯托米·丹尼尔斯出现在法庭上是代表检方讲述一个令人不舒服的故事，

sentences.en: and has the kind of details that Donald Trump would be motivated to try to hide.
sentences.zh: 并且包含了唐纳德·特朗普有动机试图掩盖的那种细节。

sentences.en: And therefore, this defense strategy is to say, those details about what Trump might want to hide, you can't trust them.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种辩护策略是说，那些关于特朗普可能想要掩盖什么的细节，你不能相信。

sentences.en: So does this back and forth effectively hurt Stormy Daniels' credibility in your estimation?
sentences.zh: 那么在你看来，这种来回交锋是否有效地损害了斯托米·丹尼尔斯的可信度？

sentences.en: I don't think that Stormy Daniels came off as perfectly credible about everything she testified about.
sentences.zh: 我不认为斯托米·丹尼尔斯在她作证的所有事情上都显得完全可信。

sentences.en: And there are incidents that were unclear or confusing.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些事件是不清楚或令人困惑的。

sentences.en: There were things she talked about that I found hard to believe when she, for instance, denied that she had attacked Trump in a tweet or talked about her motivations.
sentences.zh: 她谈到的一些事情，例如当她否认自己在推文中攻击特朗普或谈论她的动机时，我觉得很难相信。

sentences.en: But about what prosecutors need, that central story, the story of having had sex with him, we can't know whether it happened.
sentences.zh: 但关于检方需要的东西，那个核心故事，即与他发生性关系的故事，我们无法知道它是否真的发生过。

sentences.en: But there weren't that many disparities in these accounts over the years.
sentences.zh: 但这些年来，这些描述中并没有太多的差异。

sentences.en: In terms of things that would make me doubt the story that Daniels was telling, details that don't add up, those weren't present.
sentences.zh: 就那些会让我怀疑丹尼尔斯所讲故事的事情，即那些对不上的细节而言，这些并不存在。

sentences.en: And you don't have to take my word for that, nor should you.
sentences.zh: 你不需要听我的，也不应该只听我的。

sentences.en: But the judge is in the room, and he says something very, very similar.
sentences.zh: 但法官在场，他说了一些非常、非常相似的话。

sentences.en: What does he say?
sentences.zh: 他说什么了？

sentences.en: And why does he say it?
sentences.zh: 他为什么这么说？

sentences.en: Well, he does it when the defense, again, at the end of the day, on Thursday, calls for a mistrial.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他是在周四结束时，辩方再次要求宣布审判无效时说的。

sentences.en: With a similar argument as before?
sentences.zh: 带着和之前类似的论点？

sentences.en: Not only with a similar argument as before, but like almost the exact same argument.
sentences.zh: 不仅论点与之前相似，简直可以说是完全一样的论点。

sentences.en: And I would say that I was astonished to see them do this, but I wasn't because I've covered other trials where Trump is the client.
sentences.zh: 我本想说看到他们这样做我很惊讶，但我并不惊讶，因为我报道过其他特朗普作为当事人的审判。

sentences.en: And in those trials, the lawyers again and again called for a mistrial.
sentences.zh: 在那些审判中，律师们一次又一次地要求宣告审判无效。

sentences.en: And what does Judge Marchand say in response to this second effort to seek a mistrial?
sentences.zh: 那么，马尔尚法官对这第二次寻求宣告审判无效的努力有何回应呢？

sentences.en: Now, let me say to this one, he seems a little less patient.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我来说说这一次，他似乎少了一点耐心。

sentences.en: He says that after the first mistrial ruling, two days before, he went into his chambers, and he read every decision he had made about the case.
sentences.zh: 他说，在两天前第一次驳回宣告审判无效的裁决后，他回到办公室，重读了他对该案所做的每一项决定。

sentences.en: He took this moment to reflect on the first decision.
sentences.zh: 他利用这段时间反思了第一个决定。

sentences.en: And he found that he had, in his own estimation, which is all he has, been fair and not allowed evidence that was prejudicial to Trump into this trial.
sentences.zh: 他发现，按照他自己的评估——这也是他唯一能做的——他一直很公正，没有允许对特朗普有偏见证据进入审判。

sentences.en: It could continue.
sentences.zh: 审判可以继续。

sentences.en: And so he said that again.
sentences.zh: 所以他再次重申了这一点。

sentences.en: And then he really almost turned on the defense.
sentences.zh: 然后他几乎把矛头转向了辩方。

sentences.en: And he said that the things that the defense was objecting to were things that the defense had made happen.
sentences.zh: 他说辩方反对的事情，正是辩方自己一手造成的。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: He says that in their opening statement, the defense could have taken issue with many elements of the case about whether they were falsified business records,
sentences.zh: 他说在开庭陈述中，辩方本可以就案件的许多要素提出异议，比如它们是否属于伪造商业记录，

sentences.en: about any of the other things that prosecutors are saying happened.
sentences.zh: 或者检察官所说的其他任何事情。

sentences.en: But instead, he says, they focused their energy on denying that Trump ever had sex with Daniels.
sentences.zh: 但他说，他们反而把精力集中在否认特朗普曾与丹尼尔斯发生过性关系上。

sentences.en: And so that was essentially an invitation to the prosecution to call Stormy Daniels as a witness and have her say from the stand, yes, I had this sexual encounter.
sentences.zh: 所以这本质上是在邀请检方传唤斯托米·丹尼尔斯作为证人，并让她在证人席上说，是的，我确实有过这次性接触。

sentences.en: The upshot of it is that the judge not only takes the defense to task, but he also just says that he finds Stormy Daniels' narrative credible.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，法官不仅批评了辩方，还直言他认为斯托米·丹尼尔斯的叙述是可信的。

sentences.en: He doesn't see it as having changed so much from year to year.
sentences.zh: 他认为她的说法并没有逐年发生太大变化。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So in thinking back to our original question here, Jonah, about the idea that putting Stormy Daniels on the stand was risky,
sentences.zh: 那么回想我们最初的问题，乔纳，关于让斯托米·丹尼尔斯出庭作证是有风险的这一想法，

sentences.en: I wonder if by the end of this entire journey, you're reevaluating that idea.
sentences.zh: 我不知道在整个过程结束时，你是否在重新评估这个想法。

sentences.en: Because it doesn't sound like it ended up being super risky.
sentences.zh: 因为它听起来并没有变得风险极大。

sentences.en: It sounded like it ended up working reasonably well for the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 听起来它最终对检方来说效果相当不错。

sentences.en: Well, let me just assert that it doesn't really matter what I think.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我声明一下，我的想法其实并不重要。

sentences.en: The jury is going to decide this.
sentences.zh: 陪审团会做出决定。

sentences.en: There's 12 people and we can't know what they're thinking.
sentences.zh: 有12个人，我们无法知道他们在想什么。

sentences.en: But my impression was that while she was being questioned by the prosecution for the prosecution's case,
sentences.zh: 但我的印象是，当她在检方举证阶段接受检方质询时，

sentences.en: Stormy Daniels was a real liability.
sentences.zh: 斯托米·丹尼尔斯确实是一个负担。

sentences.en: She was a difficult witness for them.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，她是一个难缠的证人。

sentences.en: And the judge said as much.
sentences.zh: 法官也这么说了。

sentences.en: But when the defense cross-examined her,
sentences.zh: 但当辩方对她进行交叉盘问时，

sentences.en: Stormy Daniels became a better witness, in part because their struggles to discredit her may have actually ended up making her story look more credible and stronger.
sentences.zh: 斯托米·丹尼尔斯反而成了一名更好的证人，部分原因是他们试图抹黑她的努力，实际上可能反而让她的故事看起来更可信、更有力了。

sentences.en: And the reason that matters is because, remember, we said that prosecutors are trying to fill this hole in their case.
sentences.zh: 这之所以重要，是因为请记住，我们说过检察官正试图填补他们案件中的这个漏洞。

sentences.en: Well, now they have.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在他们填补上了。

sentences.en: The jury has met Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 陪审团已经见过了斯托米·丹尼尔斯。

sentences.en: They've heard her account.
sentences.zh: 他们听取了她的陈述。

sentences.en: They've made of it what they will.
sentences.zh: 他们会做出自己的判断。

sentences.en: And now the sequence of events that prosecutors are trying to line up as they seek prison time for the former president really makes a lot of sense.
sentences.zh: 现在，检察官在寻求判处前总统监禁时试图串联起来的事件顺序，确实非常有逻辑。

sentences.en: It starts with what Stormy Daniels says with sex in a hotel suite in 2006.
sentences.zh: 它始于斯托米·丹尼尔斯所说的2006年在酒店套房发生的性行为。

sentences.en: It picks up years later as Donald Trump is trying to win an election and prosecutors say suppressing negative stories, including Stormy Daniels' very negative story.
sentences.zh: 几年后，当唐纳德·特朗普试图赢得选举时，检方称他压制负面报道，包括斯托米·丹尼尔斯非常负面的故事。

sentences.en: And the story that prosecutors are telling ends with Donald Trump orchestrating the falsification of business records to keep that story concealed.
sentences.zh: 而检察官讲述的故事以唐纳德·特朗普策划伪造商业记录以掩盖该故事而告终。

sentences.en: Well, Jonah, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，乔纳，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: The prosecution's next major witness will be Michael Cohen, the former Trump fixer who arranged for the hush money payment to Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 检方的下一位主要证人将是迈克尔·科恩，这位曾为特朗普处理麻烦的前助手，曾安排向斯托米·丹尼尔斯支付封口费。

sentences.en: Cohen is expected to take the stand on Monday.
sentences.zh: 预计科恩将于周一出庭作证。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Thursday, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu issued a defiant response to warnings from the United States that it would stop supplying weapons to Israel
sentences.zh: 周四，以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡对美国发出的警告做出了挑衅性的回应，美国曾警告如果以色列入侵加沙南部城市拉法，将停止向以色列提供武器。

sentences.en: if Israel invades the southern Gaza city of Rafa.
sentences.zh: 如果以色列入侵加沙南部城市拉法。

sentences.en: So far, Israel has carried out a limited incursion into the city where a million civilians are sheltering, but has threatened a full invasion.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，以色列对这座有百万平民避难的城市进行了有限的入侵，但已威胁要进行全面入侵。

sentences.en: In a statement, Netanyahu said, If we need to stand alone, we will stand alone.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在一份声明中说：如果我们必须独自站立，我们就会独自站立。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, high-level ceasefire negotiations between Israel and Hamas have been put on hold, in part because of anger over Israel's incursion into Rafa.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，以色列和哈马斯之间的高级别停火谈判已被搁置，部分原因是由于对以色列入侵拉法的愤怒。

sentences.en: A reminder, tomorrow we'll be sharing the latest episode of our colleague's new show,
sentences.zh: 提醒一下，明天我们将分享我们同事新节目的最新一集，

sentences.en: The Interview.
sentences.zh: 《采访》。

sentences.en: This week on The Interview, Lulu Garcia Navarro talks with radio host Charlemagne Tha God about his frustrations with how Americans talk about politics.
sentences.zh: 本周的《采访》节目中，露露·加西亚·纳瓦罗与电台主持人查理曼大帝谈论了他对美国人谈论政治方式的沮丧。

sentences.en: If me as a black man, if I criticize Democrats, then I'm supporting MAGA.
sentences.zh: 如果我作为一个黑人批评民主党人，那我就是在支持“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）。

sentences.en: But if I criticize, you know, Donald Trump and Republicans, then I'm a Democratic shill.
sentences.zh: 但如果我批评唐纳德·特朗普和共和党人，那我就是民主党的走狗。

sentences.en: Why can't I just be a person who deals in nuance?
sentences.zh: 为什么我就不能是一个讲究细微差别的人呢？

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Olivia Natt and Michael Simon-Johnson.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由奥利维亚·纳特和迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lexi Diao with help from Paige Cowett, contains original music by Will Reed and Marian Lozano, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由莱克西·迪奥编辑，佩奇·考特协助，包含威尔·里德和玛丽安·洛萨诺的原创音乐，并由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: For The Daily, I'm Michael Bawarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On Monday.
sentences.zh: 在周一。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的《地铁》最新一集中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在此过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
